ApiErrors.title: Couldn't complete that
ApiErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was lost — try again.
ApiErrors.invalid: Some of what you entered can't be accepted. Check the details and try again.
ApiErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that here. Ask a workspace admin.
ApiErrors.notFound: That record is no longer available.
ApiErrors.conflict: Someone else changed this just now. Reload and try again.
ApiErrors.tooManyRequests: That's a lot of requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
ApiErrors.offline: We couldn't reach Connex. Check your connection and try again.
ApiErrors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was lost — try again in a moment.
ApiErrors.sessionExpired: You've been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
ApiErrors.identityCollisionReportTimeout: That report is taking longer than expected. Try again in a moment.
ApiErrors.sharePrivacyHold: This contact asked not to be shared outside this workspace, so new shares are blocked.

ErrorState.title: Something went wrong
ErrorState.body: We couldn't load this page. The issue is usually temporary.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find that
NotFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it was moved or deleted.

site.body: This page doesn't exist. Check the address, or head back to the start.

records.body: This record doesn't exist, or it was deleted. It may also belong to a different workspace.

activity.body: This item doesn't exist, or it was deleted. It may also belong to a different workspace.

library.body: This document or file doesn't exist, or it was deleted.

reports.body: This report doesn't exist, or it was deleted.

AccessDenied.title: You don't have access
AccessDenied.body: You may be in the wrong workspace, or your role doesn't include permission to view this. Try switching workspace, signing in again, or asking a workspace admin.

PermissionsUnavailable.title: We couldn't confirm your permissions
PermissionsUnavailable.body: This page stays hidden until we can check what you're allowed to see. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.
PermissionsUnavailable.sectionBody: This section stays hidden until we can check what you're allowed to see. The issue is usually temporary.

WorkspaceUnavailable.title: We couldn't check your workspaces
WorkspaceUnavailable.body: Your workspace access couldn't be confirmed. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.

CapabilityUnavailable.title: We couldn't check feature availability
CapabilityUnavailable.body: Feature availability couldn't be confirmed. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.

SectionUnavailable.title: Couldn't load this
SectionUnavailable.body: This section couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
